option_analysis.summary: Use Python http.server and unittest with no external dependency.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Lower UI realism but gives deterministic real HTTP evidence without stack setup noise.

option_analysis.summary: Introduce a frontend framework and browser-app build pipeline.
option_analysis.tradeoff: More product-like UI but adds dependencies unrelated to the pilot validation target.

option_analysis.summary: Read credentials from environment variables at process start.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Keeps secrets deployment-owned and testable without committing sensitive defaults.

option_analysis.summary: Store pilot credentials in source or canonical product artifacts.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Simpler local startup but leaks secret ownership into design and fixtures.

option_analysis.summary: Store sessions server-side and expose only an opaque HttpOnly SameSite cookie.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Keeps session state out of the browser while accepting in-memory pilot limits.

option_analysis.summary: Put user identity or session state directly in a client-readable cookie.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Reduces server state but exposes tampering and privacy risk.

option_analysis.summary: Use real HTTP requests in tests against the running server boundary.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Costs a little setup time but proves the route, cookie, and rendering path together.

option_analysis.summary: Test handlers directly with unit-only calls.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Faster tests but misses wiring, HTTP semantics, and browser-facing behavior.

interfaces.contract_summary: GET /login renders the form; POST /login validates configured credentials and returns a session cookie on success.

input_params.name: username
input_params.validation: must equal the configured login username
input_params.description: Submitted login identity from the POST /login form.

input_params.name: password
input_params.validation: must equal the configured login password
input_params.description: Submitted login secret from the POST /login form.

output_params.name: session_cookie
output_params.description: Opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie plus redirect to / on successful login.

error_codes.condition: submitted username or password is missing or does not match configured credentials

boundary_behaviors.scenario: valid, invalid, and malformed login submissions
boundary_behaviors.expected_behavior: valid credentials create a server-side session cookie and redirect; invalid or malformed credentials do not create an authenticated session and keep a stable failure response

interfaces.contract_summary: GET / redirects anonymous users and renders homepage content for active session cookies.

input_params.name: session
input_params.validation: must match an active server-side session token
input_params.description: Browser session cookie used to resolve the homepage user.

output_params.name: homepage_html
output_params.description: Protected homepage content for valid sessions; anonymous or stale sessions redirect to /login.

error_codes.condition: session cookie is missing, unknown, or stale

boundary_behaviors.scenario: anonymous, valid, and stale session cookie access to home
boundary_behaviors.expected_behavior: anonymous or stale cookies redirect to login; a valid active session renders the protected homepage without exposing session internals

interfaces.contract_summary: POST /logout removes the server-side token and sends an expired session cookie.

input_params.name: session
input_params.validation: may be active, missing, or stale; logout stays idempotent
input_params.description: Browser session cookie to invalidate when present.

output_params.name: expired_session_cookie
output_params.description: Expired session cookie plus redirect to /login.

error_codes.condition: unexpected server failure while clearing session state

boundary_behaviors.scenario: logout with active, missing, or stale session cookie
boundary_behaviors.expected_behavior: logout is idempotent, clears the browser cookie, invalidates server state when present, and prevents stale cookie reuse

boundary_behaviors.scenario: logout receives an already-cleared or unknown session cookie
boundary_behaviors.expected_behavior: logout still redirects to login, sends an expired cookie, and leaves no active session

data_architecture.summary: Session tokens are stored in process-local memory; credentials are read from environment variables; no durable storage or external datasource is introduced.
storage_decisions: Use in-memory session storage because the pilot validates standard-chain flow, not production session durability.
data_flows: POST /login validates configured credentials, creates an opaque session token, and GET / uses the token to render the homepage.
data_architecture.consistency_strategy: Logout removes the server-side token before sending an expired cookie so stale cookies fail closed.

cross_cutting_concerns.decision: Use environment-owned credentials, opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies, and server-side session invalidation.
Missing config, invalid form length, invalid credentials, unknown sessions, and unknown routes return readable failures.
Invalid login attempts remain visible in default HTTP access logs.
Credentials are supplied by LOGIN_HOMEPAGE_USERNAME and LOGIN_HOMEPAGE_PASSWORD environment variables.
